title: derivedExtUnit iso
statement: For exact additive functors U,V:A→B and an isomorphism ε:U≅V, if e∈Ext^n(F,UH) is a derived Ext unit [def-sp-derived-scalar-ext-unit], then e composed with mk0(ε_H) is a V-derived Ext unit.

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: The derived natural isomorphism sends each target Hom set for U to the corresponding one for V. Compose this bijection with the unit bijection for e. Naturality of the exact-functor single comparison and the shift equation for the derived natural isomorphism identify the composed function with the unit function of e composed with mk0(ε_H).

theorem derivedExtUnit_iso (ε : U ≅ V) (F : B) (H : A) (n : ℕ)
    (η : Ext.{wE} F (U.obj H) n) (h : U.DerivedExtUnit F H n η) :
    V.DerivedExtUnit F H n (η.comp (Ext.mk₀ (ε.hom.app H)) (add_zero n))
